changelog:
lygo-context-guard v1.0.0

- Initial release of LYGO Context Guard skill for AI agent context management.
- Provides local commands to estimate token usage, redact secrets, compact/pack content, and enforce token budgets before model calls.
- Key features: bulk secret redaction, deterministic context compaction, dual heuristic token estimation, exit codes for budget compliance.
- No network, shell, or subprocess usage; all processing is local and reproducible.
- CLI commands: estimate, redact, compact, budget, toolpack, preflight, and demo.
summary: LYGO Context Guard — pre-flight token budget, secret redaction, and deterministic context compaction for AI agents. Use when stuffing tool dumps, logs, files, or long chats into a model; when context is too large; when you need to save tokens / reduce API cost; when you must redact API keys before re-injection. Pure local stdlib. No network, no subprocess. Commands: estimate, redact, compact, budget, toolpack, preflight. Install clawhub:@deepseekoracle/lygo-context-guard.
